evals.name: cli-contract-e2e
evals.prompt: (no LLM) run_cli_e2e.py exercises one durable multi-source planner, checkpoints and retry, Refresh invalidation, dossier fan-out, composition review, stable-ID Page DAG readiness, logical-link binding, independent page review and OKF Publication
evals.expected_output: passed true; exit 0 on Windows, Linux and macOS

evals.name: java-multi-source
evals.prompt: You are the coordinator for repo-wiki. Workspace: {WS}. Skill: {SKILL_DIR}. Read SKILL.md first. Dispatch only ready_targets, preserve attempt tokens, use bounded navigation, consume path-only Handoffs, and never bypass a rejected State Gate.
evals.expected_output: published thin wiki, 0 validation errors, honest citations
assertions: Run reached published and every plan/page/review Target is complete
one long-lifecycle Workspace planner owns the cross-Source Knowledge Plan and persists a checkpoint
one digest-bound Plan review approved before dossier research became ready
every active Knowledge Unit has one dossier and is assigned exactly once by the Composition Map
one digest-bound Composition review approved before page writing became ready
write and review Target identities use stable page IDs rather than Markdown paths
page writers became ready only after every page named by depends_on was Machine-confirmed
one bounded compact Source outline exists per Revision and semantic anchors remain visible
the published page set exactly matches the reviewed Composition Map without requiring fixed root pages
at least one source-owned concept exists and every source-owned concept has evidence seeds
re-running okf.py validate --published reports 0 errors
sampled cited line ranges exist in the pinned sources (anti-fabrication)
proposal files are well-formed when present; zero files is allowed
every page description is non-empty (routing text)
each independent approved review is bound to its exact subject digest and final paths match the Composition Map
structured host trace has no direct run-state inspection, failed locator reads or CLI help recovery probes
OKF reserved files and lifecycle trust fields conform

evals.name: killbill-finance-multi-repository
evals.prompt: Run run_live_eval.py with --scenario killbill as an opt-in high-cost domain-recall and review-convergence QA run.
evals.fixture: setup_java_ws.py --scenario killbill (four fixed Kill Bill revisions)
evals.expected_output: published thin wiki that connects billing domains across API, implementation, commons and platform repositories
assertions: Plan distinguishes public API contracts from the implementation repository's internal APIs
one long-lifecycle plan:workspace owns all four Sources without per-Source Plan shards
Knowledge Plan covers catalog plans/phases, subscription versus entitlement, usage/metering, invoice/payment/overdue, durable queues, service lifecycle and plugins
Composition groups durable concepts instead of creating one page per Maven module or package
Chinese runs use Chinese page titles and routing descriptions
review:plan catches domain and evidence defects before dossier fan-out
review:composition routes split, merge and move defects to page:compose
Composition separates Domain, Flow and Lifecycle questions and review audits representation semantics
Chinese Composition Maps localize Diagram Spec questions
a repair review converges without reopening already-resolved issues
the published architecture and overview connect all four repositories
